questions.solution_md:

Kvadrat yuzi diagonali orqali: $S=\frac{d^2}{2}=\frac{64}{2}=32$.

$V=Sh=32\cdot8=256$.

kaa.solution_md:
Prizma diagonalı, tiykar diagonalı hám jan qabırǵa tuwrı múyeshli úshmúyeshlik payda etedi: $h=4\cdot\tan30^{\circ}=\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{3}$.

Kvadrat maydanı diagonalı arqalı: $S=\frac{d^2}{2}=\frac{16}{2}=8$.

$V=Sh=8\cdot\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{3}=\frac{32}{3}\sqrt{3}$.

en.solution_md:
The diagonal of the prism, the diagonal of the base and a lateral edge form a right triangle: $h=4\cdot\tan30^{\circ}=\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{3}$.

The area of a square from its diagonal: $S=\frac{d^2}{2}=\frac{16}{2}=8$.

$V=Sh=8\cdot\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{3}=\frac{32}{3}\sqrt{3}$.
en.mistake_note_md: Taking the area of the square as $d^2$ (forgetting the factor $\frac12$) or mixing up the tangent values.
